message:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
Just a quick note to confirm that I can deliver this by mid-afternoon on Friday (12/8) without any issue.

Enjoy your day.
-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]! I’ll be OOO on both Friday and Monday. Could you share your work in a Google Doc with [EMAIL_001] and <http:[EMAIL_002]?[EMAIL_003]?> They can look it over while I’m away, and once I return to the office on Tuesday, I can send your payment and feedback.
That’s no problem, and thank you for the guidance. I’ll add those individuals to the share settings. Enjoy your weekend!

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
A few days have passed since we last spoke, so I wanted to check and make sure my deliverable reached you.
Thank you, and enjoy the rest of your day!
-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]!

Thank you for checking in. I’ve now finished reviewing your article, and you did excellent work. The writing is strong, though the blog could be improved further by adding a little more storytelling—for example, engaging introductions that break up lengthy informational lists. My team and I left feedback in the article for you to review and incorporate through the relevant edits.

Once you’ve reviewed the comments and made the edits, we’ll be ready to send your test article to our client. We really appreciate the work you’ve done here, and I’m looking forward to receiving the revised version.

Fire&Spark feedback on the article: [URL_001]

Please reach out if you have any questions!

Thanks,
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
It’s good to hear from you. I’ll go through the edits you provided. By when would you like me to complete and return the updated draft?

-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]
It would be ideal to receive them by tomorrow morning. However, if that turnaround is too fast, submitting them by the end of the week will also be fine.

ok. I’ll see what I’m able to put together.
I do have one general question about the comments. I saw the overall request to add more content/words, which is fine and something I can do. My original approach was to make the content very concise so it would stay below the blog’s 1000 words requirement. If going slightly over is acceptable, I can certainly add more introductions in the places you noted. I just wanted to confirm that the word count was not a hard limit.
The word count is not a hard limit, though I appreciate your attention to detail on this!

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I believe I’ve now handled your comments in the google doc you shared. I kept the one comment you had open so that you can view my resolution.
[URL_002]

I enjoyed working on this project and hope we’ll have another opportunity to collaborate soon!
-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

The blog looks excellent, and the edits are exactly what we wanted. The next step is for us to send your test article to our client. After they have reviewed and approved your work, I’ll get back in touch to talk about a monthly copywriting cadence, compensation, and timeframes.

We’ll talk soon!
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

That’s fantastic news! I’m very happy to hear it.
I look forward to hearing from you again soon. If we don’t reconnect until afterward, I hope you and the team enjoy a good weekend and a restful holiday season.

-[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I realize we’re very close to the end of the year and in the middle of the holiday season, but I wanted to check whether you’ve received any feedback from your client about the test article I completed. Whenever you’re ready, I’m available to begin!

Wishing you a relaxing end to the year!
-[FREELANCER_NAME_001] G.

Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_002] you for following up, and I hope your holiday weekend was great! Our client’s site recently launched, so the past few weeks have been hectic. They still haven’t reviewed your work, but I’m hoping they’ll provide feedback sometime this week. As soon as I have more information, I’ll follow up with you.

Happy New Year,
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I have great news! Century Spring has reviewed your work and would like to schedule a meeting with you. They want to hear more about your background and share some context about their company and brand. Please tell me whether you’re available for a call this week.

The team also shared feedback and suggested edits for your test article, which are available here: [URL_003]

Let me know if anything is unclear or if you have questions!

In addition to arranging this meeting, my team wants to give you your next copywriting assignment. Rather than creating a blog article this time, you’ll revise the copy on an existing landing page at [URL_004]. I can provide the brief tomorrow. Regarding your rates, approximately how many hours do you anticipate needing for a copy editing project?

Thanks!

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I’d be very happy to meet with Century Spring, and thank you for forwarding their feedback! I don’t know which time slots are open, but I’m best available any day this week before 11am EST, as well as Tuesday/Wednesday/Friday this week after 1pm EST. Unfortunately, my schedule is fairly full this afternoon (Monday), so I’m unable to meet then.

I’ll review that landing page and send you an estimate of the hours this afternoon.

The only broader question I have is this: if the Century Spring meeting goes well and they’re interested in what I can provide, how much work do you expect the overall project to involve? I’m asking because having more project information helps me plan and prioritize my time more effectively.

Thanks!
-[FREELANCER_NAME_001] G.

Excellent! I’ll share your availability with them and then follow up by sending a Google Meets invitation. Which email address should I use for the invite?

This is the specific landing page you’ll revise: [URL_005]. Just as with the previous brief, we’ll give you detailed directions about what we want included in each section.

At this point, we anticipate approximately 4 assignments per month. Because blogs are expected to require more time than copy-editing assignments, we may replace 1 blog with 2 copy-editing tasks when necessary.

I use a dedicated email address for work of this kind. Please send it to: [EMAIL_004]

Thanks for clarifying the workflow!

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001]:
I believe a reasonable estimate for revising the copy on the page you shared is approximately **5 hours**. I’m comfortable retaining the same hourly rate I quoted for the first article ($45/hr), along with the same turnaround after receiving the contract and all materials required to begin (4 days).

I hope those terms work for you. I’m ready to start whenever you’d like me to proceed!

-[FREELANCER_NAME_001] G.
That works for me—thank you for letting me know! I can create and send a new milestone tomorrow :)
I’ve just sent you an invitation for tomorrow’s meeting at 1 pm ET!
got it. I’ll be there at that time, in case you didn’t see the google confirmation!
